svg.text: Timers run in the durable timer service, so they survive a ReleaseGate restart.
A timer firing moves Pending to Overdue and sends an alert to Compliance and Engineering.
Recording a submission cancels that deadline's timer. Met and Late are both final.
On startup, any Pending deadline without a live timer gets a new one.
